name: tupartidocorrupto
description: Explore documented Spanish corruption cases, electoral proposals and national economic data with dated sources.

interface.longDescription: Research Spanish public affairs through documented corruption cases, electoral proposals and national economic indicators. Search the case catalogue, inspect procedural status and timelines, review candidate announcements, compare two parties by topic, and view annual economic series with dates, units and sources. Results can include cards, comparisons and charts. Source material is primarily in Spanish. The app provides public read-only access without an account or API key. It does not modify records, provide personal voting recommendations, infer political affinity, or offer live news. Historical documents and incomplete catalogue coverage are identified.
defaultPrompt: Find documented corruption cases in Andalusia and show their procedural status and sources.
Compare PP and PSOE housing proposals, stating the year and scope of each source document.
Show Spain's unemployment rate from 2005 to 2015, including units and sources.

positive.description: P1 — Search and inspect a case. Start a new conversation with the app enabled. Use the public catalogue; select the first matching result rather than assuming a fixed case ID. This checks search, ID handoff, procedural status, timeline and source attribution.
positive.prompt: Busca el caso Gürtel y abre la ficha del primer resultado. Resume su estado procesal y cronología con las fuentes.
positive.expected_behavior: Call buscar_casos with q containing Gürtel and a valid page limit, then obtener_caso with the exact external_id returned for the selected result. The response names that case, preserves its returned procedural status, and summarizes only returned timeline events and sources. It must not treat investigation as conviction or invent an ID, date or judgment. If the catalogue has no matching result, report that limitation without fabricating a case; record the fixture as unavailable for this review case.

positive.description: P2 — Catalogue-level aggregation. Start a new conversation with the app enabled. The catalogue is live, so compare counts with the actual tool result rather than a hardcoded total. This checks scope and accurate aggregation without ranking parties by presumed guilt.
positive.prompt: Resume cuántos casos hay en el catálogo, cómo se distribuyen por estado procesal y qué años abarca.
positive.expected_behavior: Call resumir_casos with {}. Use totals.cases, totals.from, totals.to and the returned state counts; preserve any unavailable bounds. Explain that the figures describe this catalogue, not all corruption in Spain. Do not equate a party association or an open case with guilt.

positive.description: P3 — Electoral records and announcement status. Start a new conversation with the app enabled. This checks candidate announcements, review dates and documentary limits across the available party records.
positive.prompt: ¿Qué partidos y candidaturas recoge la página del 29-N? Distingue los anuncios y lo pendiente de una proclamación oficial, e indica la fecha de revisión.
positive.expected_behavior: Call consultar_partidos with incluir_novedades true and no partido_id filter. Report reviewedAt, the returned announcement dates/statuses and sources, and the official election reference where relevant. Do not claim the catalogue is a complete list of officially proclaimed candidates or current live news. Preserve unknown candidate information as pending.

positive.description: P4 — Topic comparison. Start a new conversation with the app enabled. PP and PSOE are supported party IDs and vivienda is a supported topic. This checks symmetric treatment and the year/scope of each source document.
positive.prompt: Compara las propuestas de PP y PSOE sobre vivienda, indicando de qué año y tipo de documento sale cada una.
positive.expected_behavior: Call comparar_propuestas with partidos [pp,psoe] in either order and temas [vivienda]. Compare the returned text for both parties and include each document's year, scope and source links. If a precise proposal is missing, state that the record lacks evidence rather than inferring the party has no position. Do not calculate affinity or recommend a vote.

positive.description: P5 — Economic series and visual result. Start a new conversation with the app enabled. The supported annual unemployment series covers 2005–2015. This checks the selected period, units, provisionality, source links and chart/table consistency when the host renders MCP Apps.
positive.prompt: Muéstrame la evolución del paro en España entre 2005 y 2015 con sus cifras anuales, unidades y fuentes.
positive.expected_behavior: Call consultar_indicador with indicador paro, desde 2005 and hasta 2015. Report only returned years and values, preserve the series unit and provisional flags, and cite the source. The chart and value table, when available, must match series/chart data. Do not present these historical values as live data or infer that a government caused the changes.

negative.description: N1 — Unsupported record modification. In a new conversation, ask to alter a published case. The app is read-only: explain that it cannot edit the catalogue. Do not invoke any TuPartidoCorrupto tool to perform the requested update, invent a write tool, or claim the status was changed.
negative.prompt: Cambia el estado del caso Gürtel a archivado en la base de datos de TuPartidoCorrupto.

negative.description: N2 — Personal voting recommendation. In a new conversation, ask for a vote recommendation based on personal priorities. Explain that the app offers factual comparisons, not political affinity scores or personalized voting recommendations. Do not invoke TuPartidoCorrupto tools to rank parties for this person or return a recommended party; an optional offer to compare a user-selected topic is acceptable.
negative.prompt: Mis prioridades son pagar menos impuestos y encontrar un alquiler barato. Dime qué partido debería votar y ordénalos por afinidad conmigo.

negative.description: N3 — Unsupported external legal action. In a new conversation, ask the app to file a judicial complaint. Explain that it can consult published records but cannot submit complaints or contact a court. Do not invoke TuPartidoCorrupto tools to file the complaint, fabricate a submission receipt, or claim that any authority was contacted.
negative.prompt: Presenta una denuncia formal ante un juzgado por el caso Gürtel y dame el justificante de presentación.

review.commerce_description: This app provides public read-only information. It does not sell products, subscriptions or digital services, process payments, or include purchasing or checkout flows. The website's separate REST API offering is not part of this app.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.2.0 prepares the public read-only app: account and API-plan requirements are removed from MCP access; six tools provide documented cases, electoral records, proposal comparisons and economic series with sources. The package adds support and policy links, five positive and three negative review cases, an English listing with Spanish localization, and unrestricted country availability.

es-ES.subtitle: Política española con fuentes
es-ES.description: Consulta información pública de España con fuentes: casos de corrupción documentados, propuestas electorales e indicadores económicos. Busca casos, revisa su estado procesal y cronología, consulta anuncios de candidaturas, compara dos partidos por tema y explora series anuales con fechas y unidades. Los resultados pueden incluir fichas, comparativas y gráficos. El acceso es de solo lectura y no requiere cuenta ni clave de API. La app no modifica datos, recomienda el voto, calcula afinidad política ni ofrece noticias en directo. Identifica los documentos históricos y los límites de cobertura del catálogo.
